title: CypherMAS: Benchmarking Routing Reliability in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.33242v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-agent systems (MAS) built on large language models (LLMs) distribute reasoning across specialized agents that must exchange messages and invoke tools reliably. Existing evaluations typically couple communication with open domain tasks, making it difficult to determine whether a failure arises from reasoning, malformed tool use, lost messages, or forgotten requests. Prior benchmarks do not isolate communication execution or measure routing redundancy against a known optimal path. We introduce CypherMAS, a synthetic benchmark that isolates communication and routing in fixed multi-agent graphs. Agents in chain, star, bipartite, or ring graphs route cyphered messages to remote peers holding the matching decoders; since the optimal route is known, redundant LLM calls can be measured and routing failures may be easily tracked. translated_title: CypherMAS：基于大语言模型的多智能体系统路由可靠性基准测试
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）构建的多智能体系统（MAS）将推理任务分布于多个专门的智能体，这些智能体必须可靠地交换消息并调用工具。现有评估通常将通信与开放领域任务耦合在一起，因此难以判断故障究竟源于推理错误、格式不当的工具使用、消息丢失还是请求遗忘。先前的基准测试既没有隔离通信执行过程，也没有针对已知最优路径来度量路由冗余。我们提出了CypherMAS，一个在固定多智能体图中隔离通信与路由的合成基准测试。在链形、星形、二部图或环形图结构中的智能体将加密消息路由到持有匹配解码器的远程同伴；由于最优路径已知，因此可以度量冗余的LLM调用，并轻松追踪路由故障。在从4B到753B参数的十一个开放权重模型中，小型模型在路由和工具使用方面表现不佳，稠密模型（原文摘要此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出CypherMAS合成基准，通过让智能体在固定图结构（链形、星形、二部图、环形）中将加密消息路由至持有匹配解码器的目标节点，首次实现了对LLM多智能体系统路由可靠性与冗余度的可量化、可隔离评估。
en_tdlr: CypherMAS is a synthetic benchmark that isolates communication and routing in fixed multi-agent graphs by having agents route cyphered messages to peers holding matching decoders, enabling measurable evaluation of routing reliability and redundancy in LLM-based multi-agent systems.
